description: This Java source file defines the OptionsController class in a Spring MVC application, managing CRUD operations for product options within an administrative interface for an e-commerce platform. The controller handles listing, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting product options through various HTTP endpoints, integrating with services and models related to product options, languages, and merchant stores.

classes.name: OptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing product options in admin panel, providing endpoints for listing, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and removing product options.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the product options list page.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the edit form for a specific product option by ID.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Generates the form data for creating or editing a product option, including populating descriptions for different languages.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a product option, validating input and persisting changes.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Processes AJAX POST request to return paginated or filtered list of product options in JSON format.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST request to delete a product option by ID, ensuring authorization and correctness.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets navigation menu context in the model for rendering views.
